name: Castelaria

seo.title: Castelaria — A Transylvanian Estate in Bran | Jet Crust
seo.description: Castelaria is an 800 sqm private estate in Bran, Transylvania. Endless marble pool, 165-inch cinema, dual saunas, wine cellar and a river garden, a 12-minute walk from Bran Castle. Sleeps 16.

tagline: An 800 square metre estate where centuries of Transylvanian legend meet a private, modern sanctuary, a short walk from Bran Castle.
story_heading: Where legend keeps its distance, and comfort comes close
story: Some houses are built. Castelaria was composed. Set on nearly two thousand square metres of private grounds in the heart of Bran, the estate looks out on the same mountains and the same castle that have drawn travellers to Transylvania for generations.

Inside, the story turns quiet and modern. An endless marble pool rests beneath an illuminated ceiling and two chandeliers. A private cinema stretches across a hundred and sixty five inches. A river wraps the garden, a koi pond catches the evening light, and a separate study house waits at the far end for anyone who wants to disappear with a book.
Remodelled in full in 2023 with nothing left ordinary, Castelaria sleeps sixteen across five suites, and asks only that you stay long enough to feel it.

features.title: The Marble Pool
features.text: An endless pool for continuous swimming, finished in marble inside and out, under an illuminated Barisol ceiling and two chandeliers.

features.title: A 165-Inch Cinema
features.text: A true private theatre with 7+1 surround sound and Italian sofas long enough to seat the whole party in comfort.

features.title: Spa & Saunas
features.text: Dry and steam saunas with a cold plunge and ice bucket, a commercial-grade gym, and a marble jacuzzi for slow evenings.

features.title: Cellar & Cigars
features.text: A temperature-controlled wine cellar in premium oak, a private cigar lounge, and a poker and games room beside it.

setting.heading: A twelve minute walk from a legend
setting.lead: Castelaria sits in the folds of the Carpathians, with mountain and river views from nearly every room, and the towers of Bran Castle within sight. Full seclusion, yet moments from the town, the slopes and the story.
